purpose: Lets the user toggle a binary choice on or off, or select multiple items from a group. Each checkbox operates independently.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label text for the checkbox

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows an indeterminate state for partially selected groups

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message shown below the checkbox

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text shown below the checkbox

props.name: name
props.description: HTML name attribute for form submission

props.name: value
props.description: HTML value submitted with the form

whenToUse: For binary on/off choices such as agreeing to terms or enabling a setting
For selecting multiple items from a list simultaneously
To represent a parent item with a partially selected group of children using indeterminate state
whenNotToUse: For mutually exclusive choices where only one option can be active — use a radio group
For triggering an immediate action — use a Toggle or Button instead
antiPatterns: Using checkboxes where only one selection is allowed at a time
Using Checkbox as a navigation element
a11yNotes: Must use a native <input type='checkbox'> or role='checkbox' with full ARIA state management
Must have a visible label — do not use aria-label as the only label
Touch target must be at least 44x44 CSS pixels including the label
Focus ring must be visible and use color-interactive-focus-ring
